text: NIKE, Inc. registers its Class B Common Stock (symbol NKE) on the New York Stock Exchange; Swoosh, LLC holds 221,750,000 Class A shares, 78.8% of that class, and Class A shareholders elect 8 of the 11 directors, so the Knight family, which owns Swoosh LLC, controls the election of most of the board.
short: NIKE, Inc. is NYSE-listed (NKE); the Knight family controls 78.8% of Class A via Swoosh LLC and elects 8 of 11 directors.

source.name: NIKE, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended May 31, 2026 (SEC cover page)
source.quote: SECURITIES REGISTERED PURSUANT TO SECTION 12(B) OF THE ACT: Class B Common Stock NKE New York Stock Exchange
